About Pumptech PumpTech, headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is a premier distributor of high-quality pumping products and systems in the Pacific Northwest. As a result of the attack on The Pumptech, more than 150 GB of confidential data was stolen. This data includes more than 158,000 files containing property and maintenance documentation, documents related to owners and tenants - including personal data-financial reports, banking information, and other important company information.

New Plymouth School District (District 372) is a small public school district in Payette County, Idaho. It serves approximately 1000 students in three schools. Due to a security breach, educational records (grades, attendance, disciplinary records), personal information (names, addresses, Social Security numbers) of students and staff, and medical/health records were compromised and are being disclosed.

About Minichi Inc Minichi Inc is a certified woman-owned business with 30 years of experience in the heavy highway industry, primarily focused on bridge construction and rehabilitation. The company has successfully completed over $140 million in construction work to rebuild and repair roads and bridges in Pennsylvania. Their services include bridge construction, guide rails and road safety, and road signs. Minichi Inc aims to provide pride and excellence in their work, serving clients in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. Company Minichi was the victim of a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of more than 170 GB of confidential data. The stolen data includes blueprints, site and building plans, banking and financial information, employees’ personal data, and other important company information.
